sentences.en: Sarah was discerning enough to realize that her friends were trying to prank her.
sentences.zh: 莎拉眼光敏锐，足以意识到朋友们在捉弄她。

sentences.en: Her taste in art is quite discerning.
sentences.zh: 她在艺术品方面的品味非常敏锐。

sentences.en: He has a discerning ear for good music.
sentences.zh: 他有一双辨别好音乐的耳朵。

senses.zh: 有识别力的,有洞察力的,眼光敏锐的v.看见( discern的现在分词),识别，辨明,觉察出

mnemonic: 词根记忆：dis（加强）+cern（搞清）+ ing→能搞清楚的→有识别力的
